title: EvaluateContext
description: The `context` part of POST /v1/evaluate (TRD 8.1). Frames travel as separate multipart parts (see README). trip_id and install_id are for budget caps and logs only; the backend never sends them to the model.

install_id.description: Random id made at install. Not a device identifier.

purpose.description: select: a Stage 1 candidate; the backend decides keep or skip. describe: a button moment (TRD 7), already kept; the backend only fills in event_type and description, and always returns keep = true.

sample_t_ms.description: Trip-clock time of the last frame (frame t).

trip_type.description: From the app's trip-type config list, e.g. honeymoon, family, friends, school.

novelty.description: Normalized dhash distance from recent escalated frames.

forced.description: True for the once-a-minute forced sample.

recent_descriptions.description: Descriptions of every moment saved so far this trip, newest first, so the model can skip redundant views.
